title: Teacher & Student Password Reset Management (v0.4.34)
message: Adds educator password reset capabilities in Web Admin Portal and Android app.
changelog:
🔧 WHAT'S NEW IN v0.4.34 (EDUCATOR & STUDENT PASSWORD RESET):
• Faculty Password Reset: School Administrators and Super Admins can now dispatch official password reset emails or issue temporary passkeys to teachers directly from the Faculty & Approvals roster.
• Teacher Force Password Update: Supported forced password change dialog for educators on first login with temporary passkeys.
• Authenticated-First Reset Security: Robust account claiming and reset flow ensuring zero permission failures across Android and Web Admin Portal.
